titles.title: Parental Bereavement Leave Expansion Act of 2026
Parental Bereavement Leave Expansion Act of 2026

A bill to amend title 5, United States Code, to permit a Federal employee to take parental bereavement leave with respect to the death of a child who is younger than 26 years of age, and for other purposes.

action.text: Read twice and referred to the Committee on Homeland Security and Governmental Affairs.
